description:
Cast Raka Disciple by paying {0} due to Ragemonger.
When Raka Disciple enters the battlefield, Sethron and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Sethron trigger, creating a 2/3 Minotaur creature token.
When the Minotaur token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Raka Disciple to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
